en: Black‑and‑white image of a broad, mostly empty town square bordered by 19th‑century multi‑story buildings. In the distance on a hill stands a large fortress‑like castle complex and a tall church tower with a baroque/early‑modern spire rising above tightly packed roofs. The foreground shows long shadows across the square, a few pedestrians, and a single ornate streetlamp. Some German signage is visible on the facades of the buildings around the square.
